# Copilot repository guidance

Read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/MASTER_PLAN_V3.md`, `docs/state/PHASE.json`, `docs/quality/PRE_DEVELOPMENT_CHECKLIST.md`, `docs/quality/RELEASE_GATES.md` and affected `docs/modules`. Current phase only; tests + warnings + actual UI screenshots + help and Wiki links before completed PR; incident reports privacy protected. Follow GitHub remote truth, not prior assistant claims.

**v3.1 addition:** Follow `AGENTS.md` data durability, release qualification and user-controlled update constraints; read `docs/operations/{DATA_VAULT_BACKUP_RECOVERY,STORAGE_DOWNLOADS_RELOCATION,AUTO_RELEASE_AND_UPDATES}.md` before affected code. Do not skip verification or delete the last user data copy.

**v3.2:** Before work read `AGENTS.md` M26 rules, `docs/MASTER_PLAN_V3_2.md`, `docs/operations/CHANGE_INTELLIGENCE_CHANGELOG.md` and current change-records. Record new issues/feature changes; update Help/Wiki/screenshots in same phase PR. Never treat an opened/closed issue or mere merged PR as a shipped release. All public changelog entries require verified release proof.
